title: Domain III: Sourcing & Supplier Selection - CPPB Domain III: Sourcing & Supplier Selection - Negotiation Strategies - Public Limits
subject: CPPB Domain III: Sourcing & Supplier Selection

questions.q: Although IFBs generally strictly forbid negotiation, many public jurisdictions allow a specific exception permitting a buyer to negotiate price in an IFB ONLY if:
options: The lowest bid is from an out-of-state vendor
The lowest responsive and responsible bid exceeds the agency's available project budget
The procurement officer feels the profit margin is too high
questions.explain: When all competitive bids exceed the budgeted funds, some state/local laws allow the agency to negotiate directly with the lowest responsive/responsible bidder to reduce scope and bring the price within budget, preventing a costly re-bid.
